title: Teaching Material Metadata
description: Per EO-S1.1-002 v1.0's exact 11-field list (supersedes EO-S1.1-001 v1.1's initial reuse of Sprint AI-103's MetadataParser.js field names — that PascalCase set described a different context, the raw Metadata.json import file), plus EO-S1.1-003 v1.0's materialType addition, plus Sprint AI-119 (Platform Core Baseline) §8/§9's school/semester Repository-classification fields. Every required field must be present; unknown values are null (or [] for arrays) — never guessed or fabricated. school/semester are optional (null on a Package that predates this Sprint and hasn't been migrated yet — a real, honest 'not yet classified' state, not fabricated to fit the Baseline's own School/Semester enum before that migration actually happens).

materialId.description: Stable id, assigned once on first analysis, e.g. tm_1

school.description: Sprint AI-119 §8/§9: AHS.WorkspaceData.schools[].id (e.g. "cjsh"), or null when not yet classified.

semester.description: Sprint AI-119 §8/§9: AHS.WorkspaceData.semesters[].id (e.g. "g1s2"), or null when not yet classified.

source.description: e.g. 教科書/講義/考卷/教師補充教材 — the material's real, disclosed origin

uploadDate.description: When Project Owner provided this material, not when it was originally published

version.description: Incremented when Existing Material is updated per the Import Rule; starts at "1"

materialType.description: EO-S1.1-003. materialType=EXAM triggers the Original Question Rule: every question in this material's questions.json must be questionSource=ORIGINAL, enforced cross-file by scripts/ValidateMaterial.js.
